learning.candidate_gate: current correct gain >=1/48, historical old-correct loss <=2/72 per decision, current format >=0.95, structural validity and rollback retained
learning.memory: full original feedback, raw/abstract/skill consolidation; gated commit
learning.graph_scope: All VQA train, selection, historical VQA anchors, development and confirmation use graph; other-task anchors preserve original direct coordinate-safe interface
learning.execution_change: Controller sees only visible question, schema and observations; tools/final answer receive learned HCL guidance. Explicit finalize node; no model weight change.

confirmation.source: previously unused h_search source/pixel groups for all four roles; exclude all prior studies
confirmation.primary: GN versus G0 after one full guarded learning batch
confirmation.read_after: FROZEN_SELECTION.json after one complete learning batch
confirmation.ci: 20000 paired bootstrap draws, seed20261115; one predeclared primary
confirmation.positive: report descriptive exact-match gain separately from multiplicity-adjusted statistical evidence; no guaranteed gain

shared_answer_interface: same shortest answer / digits for count / semicolon for multiple items; no answer vocabulary; different from old experiments
limitations: all study roles newly allocated from unused h_search; not original test; patient independence unverified
one deterministic seed and frozen model; controller and tools share VLM
prior direct-trained initialization was selected in a previous experiment
non-VQA historical anchors retain unchanged direct interface
no gate relaxation, forced acceptance or outcome-based checkpoint selection
formal efficacy cannot be inferred from successful execution alone
separate small-scale expedited study running alongside the larger two-start experiment; report both, do not substitute this panel for the larger study
purpose: Time-bounded interview diagnostic: one complete guarded Agent learning update and independent 100-case confirmation

gate.historical_scope: per candidate relative to deployed predecessor; report cumulative losses separately

arm_definitions.G0: same empty initial Agent before new learning
arm_definitions.GN: Agent after one full 24-example guarded learning batch, final committed state
arm_definitions.GF: static harness, same fixed six training examples appended to graph guidance
